title: nail's internal stage times relative to each other
body: Plan item d. Pure parsing work; needs no machine time until the runs exist.

notes.author: jackroddy/01dd6c44
notes.text: Built benchmarks/stage-times: run and parse over two labels, mgy (cross, Pfam against 500k MGnify) and pid (the profmark set at pid's parameters), each with a toy. nail runs once per unit with -s and stdout kept in results/nail.<unit>.stats. parse writes stages.tbl (unit, parent, stage, secs, share, wall) where a leaf's wall is its share of its branch's wall, per Jack's approximation, and counts.tbl. Both toys run end to end in the sandbox with hits. No plot yet; the figure is meant to put the two labels side by side. Real runs not yet done.

notes.author: jackroddy/01dd6c44
notes.text: nail 1efcad84ddec (from ~/nail at 432ff65) prints the three-branch tree; installed here and both real labels rerun and parsed. MGnify 482 s: seeding 297 (prefilter 225, align 36 over 12 rounds, db write 15), alignment 176 at 93% busy, setup 9 (pipeline build 6). pid 37 s: seeding 32 (prefilter 19, db write 6.5, align 5.4 over 10 rounds), alignment 3.5. parse committed. Still no plot.
